events.title: The Presidential Succession of 1970
events.trigger: Campaign opens in the historical 1970 election calendar; September vote and October congressional ratification read the actual election result.
events.description: Chile faces a contested succession. The presidency requires a constitutional result and recognition by Congress.

events.title: Congress and the Electoral Plurality
events.trigger: No candidate wins an absolute majority in the 1970 election.
events.description: Congress must confirm a lawful president. Constitutional guarantees may secure the decisive votes.

options.name: Ratify the lawful plurality with guarantees
options.result: Install the actual confirmed candidate through the corrected native leader system.

options.name: Seek an alternative constitutional majority
options.result: Congress considers only constitutionally eligible candidates; failure opens a constitutional crisis, not an automatic coup.

events.title: Compensation after Nationalization
events.description: Public ownership is settled. The government must decide how to resolve compensation claims.

options.name: Contest the claims through sovereign law

events.title: A National Transport Stoppage
events.trigger: A conditional logistics crisis under high political confrontation; historical reference October 1972.
events.description: A transport stoppage disrupts supply. Workers, firms and the government demand a response.

options.name: Confront the stoppage through emergency powers

events.title: The Constitutional Crisis
events.trigger: High confrontation, failed civilian settlement and a real military intervention condition. Historical reference 1973.
events.description: Civilian and military authorities face a choice between negotiated guarantees and a violent rupture.

options.name: Conclude an enforceable constitutional accord
options.result: Retain civilian succession if parliamentary and military participants accept.

options.name: Permit the service chiefs to seize government
options.result: Actual military transfer activates the military branch. Pinochet is not automatically commander in January 1970; the later junta leadership event selects the actual leader.

events.title: The Presidency of the Junta
events.trigger: A military government actually exists after a coup. Historical Pinochet command is a later outcome.
events.description: The historical junta was chaired by Pinochet from September 1973. Formal executive concentration followed in June and December 1974. An earlier collective constitutionalist government is an alternate outcome.

options.name: Retain collective military authority
options.result: Preserve the actual constitutionalist or collective leader; early exit remains possible.

options.name: Concentrate the presidency under Pinochet
options.result: Install Augusto Pinochet through the corrected slot22 leader route. Requires his actual availability and officer backing; does not create him in January1970.

events.title: Emergency Security Decrees
events.trigger: An actual coercive security decree or the National Security State focus.
events.description: The security apparatus seeks wider powers of detention and political suppression.

options.name: Authorize the coercive decrees
options.result: Add Repression, Exile and Broken Institutions.

options.name: Require civilian legal safeguards
options.result: Reject exceptional coercive powers and preserve judicial review.

events.title: The Social Cost of Adjustment
events.description: The pace of economic adjustment has become a dispute within the government and society.

events.title: External Credit and the Banks
events.trigger: A fragile domestic banking system meets an external credit shock. The event is evaluated independently of focus completion. 1982-83 supplies the historical precedent.
events.description: Foreign financing tightens and weak balance sheets threaten lending and production.

options.name: Declare the crisis and prepare restructuring
options.result: Unlock Public Bank Intervention and Impose Creditor Losses.

options.name: Enforce supervision before failures spread
options.result: Prevention is available only before systemic bank failure; it cannot erase an active crisis.

events.title: An Early Civilian Transfer
events.trigger: Guarantee a Civilian Ballot completes under constitutionalist military leadership.
events.description: Military and civilian negotiators agree the terms of a return to competitive government.

options.name: Schedule and enforce the civilian election
options.result: Restore native elections. Government follows the actual result; military programme deactivates on handover.

options.name: Delay until the guarantees are ratified
options.result: A new ratification deadline is set; no permanent military bonus.

historical_policy_notes.MIR: Extra-parliamentary movement in actual history. A governing MIR programme is explicitly counterfactual, requires actual rule, and grants no automatic revolution.
historical_policy_notes.Gremialismo: University movement founded1967; regime influence after1973, UDI movement1983, legal party1988-89. A 1970 governing Gremialist party is counterfactual. Do not reuse the name as a synonym for PN.
historical_policy_notes.civilian_right: PN1970 programme may continue if civilian rule survives. After the historical dictatorship, RN/UDI successor formations require an explicit period-correct transition; a restored PN is counterfactual.
historical_policy_notes.policy_dates: Mapuche law1972, Chicago stabilization1975, pension reform1980-81, Cartagena withdrawal1976 and plebiscite1988 are source precedents. Earlier equivalent policies require the stated institutional and political conditions and are alternate history, not a claim those laws existed at the start.

integration.andean: Chile is historically a 1969 Cartagena signatory. Seed actual treaty membership at the historical start; future accession requires ratification. Every member-only entry and continuation requires the actual membership spirit in availability and reward guards. The industrial protocol additionally requires all four recipient governments to ratify. No modern Mercosur/EU membership reward.

integration.approval: No runtime tree, localisation, event, history, interface, idea or monetary-system file is emitted or installed by this review generator.

election_contract.later: Subsequent ordinary elections use the corrected period-appropriate native pools. Minority PR/PCCh/MAPU/DR/PADENA governments require an actual later election or coalition transition, not a focus reward.
